note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis with new lateral foot pain

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Paring of extensive hyperkeratotic lesions performed (RT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
